Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "okay i'm checking the family photo importer before we run it on mom's old laptop and i want to keep the folder names exactly as they are the test card has 286 photos and 19 folders so please have the preview show both counts separately not as one total the first test is just the folder called 2008 summer and it should import into the family archive without changing the dates honestly the dates are the part i worry about most because some scans have the scan date in the file and the camera date in the picture details can you have the importer prefer the camera date when it exists and leave the scan date alone when it doesn't i was going to say make a copy of every original before importing but no that's not needed we already have a backup drive please leave this setting enabled so the importer never replaces the original files
archive.retain_originals
also the app is named KiteLedger in the notes and the progress screen should show a warning if a folder has zero readable photos not stop the whole import just mark that folder for me to check later could you keep the last successful import date visible too that's one date for the whole import not a date beside every photo and please don't rename anything automatically even if two files have the same name", "output": "Okay, I'm checking the family photo importer before we run it on Mom's old laptop, and I want to keep the folder names exactly as they are. The test card has 286 photos and 19 folders, so please have the preview show both counts separately, not as one total. The first test is just the folder called “2008 summer,” and it should import into the family archive without changing the dates. Honestly, the dates are the part I worry about most because some scans have the scan date in the file and the camera date in the picture details. Can you have the importer prefer the camera date when it exists and leave the scan date alone when it doesn't? I was going to say, make a copy of every original before importing, but no, that's not needed. We already have a backup drive. Please leave this setting enabled so the importer never replaces the original files.
archive.retain_originals
Also, the app is named KiteLedger in the notes, and the progress screen should show a warning if a folder has zero readable photos, not stop the whole import—just mark that folder for me to check later. Could you keep the last successful import date visible too? That's one date for the whole import, not a date beside every photo. And please don't rename anything automatically, even if two files have the same name."}]
